name: gdrive
title: Google Drive
description: Files from Drive, downloaded and indexed. Needs a Google connection.

drives.label: Shared drives
drives.hint: Pick from the drives this Google account can see, or type IDs one per line. Leave empty to sync My Drive. Each shared drive has its own change log, so each gets its own cursor.

cache_root.label: Cache folder
cache_root.hint: Where downloaded bytes land. Defaults to this instance's own directory.
